direct.label: ZMR direct
direct.note: One-to-one forwards off Kevin's 21 Sep memo, then a second wave on 12 Oct to every name Kirsh had proposed but never mailed, then a third wave the same evening off ZMR's own equity list (1,087 contacts on Drive) and the Canyon Woods reply record. All three waves are out — 54 firms on 12 Oct alone, the last at 22:25, and nothing is left sitting in drafts. Each email opens on that firm's own last answer to us where one exists. Subject throughout: "Houston 2023 Vintage $135K/door $13M Check 20%+ IRR".

kirsh.label: Andrew Kirsh
kirsh.note: Kirsh sent to Tramview on 2 Oct, then to the three groups Zamir said he did not know — Mile Rock, Green Pine and Range Equity — on the morning of 3 Oct. All four came back. The rest of his list he raised as a question and never confirmed sending. Argosy was pulled from his list because Zamir knows them and went direct; they passed on 7 Oct.

slocumb.label: Jeremy Slocumb

He reported back on 15 Oct: three reviewing, three declined, Nelnet still out. That report is the first hard confirmation that the send happened - IPA holds the send record, we never did. He is pushing 621 Capital himself.
